import itertools

def orient_pt(pt, k=0, flip=False, n=7):
    r,c=pt
    if flip: c=n-1-c
    for _ in range(k%4):
        r,c=c,n-1-r
    return r,c
oris=[(k,f) for f in (False,True) for k in range(4)]
quads={'TL':(0,0),'TR':(0,7),'BL':(7,0),'BR':(7,7)}
# Fix 7 at TL and orientation determined by marker (6,6)->(0,0)
orient7=[(k,f) for k,f in oris if orient_pt((6,6),k,f)==(0,0)]
